nodes.label: Split Bill By KepoX
nodes.rationale: Mobile app for groups to scan receipts, split bills, and manage shared-payment history without sending receipt photos or bill data to a cloud OCR service.

nodes.label: AsyncStorage Local Persistence
nodes.rationale: Key-value local storage chosen as the only persistence layer, reinforcing local-first with no database or backend.

nodes.label: Bill History Persistence
nodes.rationale: Stores bill history plus payment status, category, payment method, and OCR correction data locally, so past corrections remain inspectable.

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated artifacts; never hand-edited. Native behavior configured through app.json and config plugins so it survives regeneration.

nodes.label: Custom Modal UI
nodes.rationale: App interface uses custom modals instead of platform dialogs for consistent cross-platform presentation.

nodes.label: Custom Development Build Requirement
nodes.rationale: Expo Go ships only bundled native modules; ML Kit is native code, so OCR cannot run in stock Expo Go. Requires npx expo run:ios|android or eas build --profile development. README repeats this warning.

nodes.label: EAS Production Build Profile (APK)
nodes.rationale: EAS production profile emits an APK for sideload distribution via GitHub Releases rather than Play Store; builds happen in the cloud so no local Android Studio toolchain is required.

nodes.label: expo-build-properties
nodes.rationale: Config plugin used to set native Android build options without editing generated native dirs.

nodes.label: Expo Image Picker
nodes.rationale: Supplies the gallery path for receipt input alongside live camera capture.

nodes.label: expo install SDK-Compatible Version Resolution
nodes.rationale: Always npx expo install instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add because it resolves versions compatible with the installed SDK, avoiding native-module mismatches.

nodes.label: Expo Router File-Based Routing
nodes.rationale: Mandated for all navigation: every file in src/app/ is a screen and _layout.tsx defines navigators, keeping non-route code out of the routes tree.

nodes.label: Lint and Typecheck Gate
nodes.rationale: npx expo lint and npx tsc --noEmit must pass before any task is declared done.

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Design intent: privacy. OCR runs on-device and history/settings stay in app-local storage so receipt data never leaves the phone. Trade-off accepted: no cloud sync or backup, and uninstalling the app loses all data.

nodes.label: Member Assignment to Items
nodes.rationale: Items can be assigned to one or several people, supporting shared dishes rather than a flat per-head split.

nodes.label: Google ML Kit Text Recognition
nodes.rationale: Chosen over cloud OCR providers so recognition happens entirely on-device. Package: @react-native-ml-kit/text-recognition.

nodes.label: No Cloud Sync or Backup
nodes.rationale: Accepted limitation of local-first: uninstall or reinstall erases local data; no built-in sync or backup exists yet.

nodes.label: On-Device OCR Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Two stages: ML Kit extracts raw text, then layout-aware parsing groups text by line and detects item/price candidates before user review.

nodes.label: Manual OCR Review and Edit
nodes.rationale: Human-in-the-loop step compensates for heuristic parsing limits; app is in development and OCR results must be checked before saving or sharing.

nodes.label: ProGuard/R8 and Resource Shrinking
nodes.rationale: Enabled for Android release builds via expo-build-properties to cut APK size.

nodes.label: Proportional Tax/Service/Discount Split
nodes.rationale: Tax, service charge, and discount are distributed proportionally to each person's subtotal so totals stay fair and sum to the receipt total.

nodes.label: QRIS Payment QR Image
nodes.rationale: Optional QRIS image can be attached to the shared bill so payers can scan directly.

nodes.label: React Navigation
nodes.rationale: README documents React Navigation with a src/navigation/ folder and App.js entry, which conflicts with AGENTS.md mandating Expo Router under src/app/. Likely stale README — flag for review.

nodes.label: Receipt Line-Layout Parsing
nodes.rationale: Heuristic, not model-based: groups OCR text by line layout and detects item/price candidates. Accuracy varies per receipt, so results are treated as suggestions requiring review.

nodes.label: Share Bill Summary
nodes.rationale: Shares via the device share sheet to a user-chosen target app, keeping the app free of any server-side distribution channel.

nodes.label: Versioned Expo Docs Lookup
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so training data is unreliable. Workflow: read expo major version from package.json, fetch docs.expo.dev/versions/v<major>.0.0/, then consult llms.txt for misconception corrections.
